dataset: LIST Tasmania 25 metre Digital Elevation Model
edition: Third edition, July 2007; official metadata revised 2025-03-12
elevation_units: metres (official metadata describes heights in metres)
vertical_datum: Not named in package README, raster PRJ or full ISO19139 metadata. Native values retained; no vertical transform.
verified_facts: Official download origin and SHA256 of each complete archive
Horizontal CRS from official metadata and package README/PRJ
25 metre grid spacing from raster geotransforms
CC BY 3.0 Australia from README and official metadata
Source accuracy statement: 90% of elevations within 5 m, caveats for steep/obscured areas
unverified: Independent survey control or geoid conversion
A historical photograph’s true camera pose
attribution: LIST Tasmania 25 metre Digital Elevation Model from theLIST © State of Tasmania; CC BY 3.0 AU. Reprojected and Terrarium encoded.
source_limitations: Derived from 10 m contours, some spot heights and known-level waterbodies; drainage not used. Grid spacing is not positional accuracy. Excludes Macquarie Island.
uploaded_file_note: The chat upload exceeds the 32 MiB transfer limit. The same named Launceston package was fetched from the official LIST origin; byte identity with the inaccessible upload is not asserted.
